title: unaudio
description: https://unaudio.marso.ar: searches, clips, shares, performance and errors

panels.title: "Nothing found"
panels.description: Share of searches with no result at all (not even a close line)

panels.title: Clips played
panels.description: Includes the clips the page pre-downloads for Compartir. Repeat plays served by Cloudflare's cache never reach the app

panels.title: Shares
panels.description: Compartir completed (reported by the page)

panels.title: Server errors
panels.description: HTTP 5xx answers

panels.title: Searches by outcome
panels.description: exact = typed phrase found; partial = last word completed; approx = typos or closest lines; none = nothing. Per minute

panels.title: Clips
panels.description: cut = ffmpeg ran; cached = already on disk; failed = ffmpeg error. Per minute

panels.title: Shares (Compartir)
panels.description: As reported by the page after the share sheet closes. Per minute

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: 429 = refused by the rate limits. Per minute

panels.title: Response time p95 by page
panels.description: 95% of requests are faster than this

panels.title: Search time
panels.description: Finding and ranking the results only (no page rendering)

panels.title: Clip cutting (ffmpeg)
panels.description: Right axis: clips being cut or waiting for one of the 2 ffmpeg slots

panels.title: Rate-limited requests
panels.description: Requests refused with 429 (too many from one visitor, or 600 clips/min for everyone)

panels.title: Clip cache size
panels.description: The app deletes the oldest clips above 300 MB

panels.title: Search index
panels.description: Changes when a new redondos.db is copied to the server

panels.title: Top "nothing found" searches
panels.description: Searches with no result at all: missing songs, misaligned lyrics, or typos the search can't fix

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (query) (count_over_time({namespace="$namespace"} | json | event="search" | outcome="none" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top songs (first result)
panels.description: Song of the first card of each search

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (top_song) (count_over_time({namespace="$namespace"} | json | event="search" | top_song!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Crashes (with traceback) and failed clip cuts. Open a line to see its trace_id

panels.title: Reports by problem
panels.description: Visitors saying a clip doesn't match. Details: tools/reports.py export + summary

panels.title: Latest reports
panels.description: Corrections are what the visitor adjusted (empty: no adjustment)

targets.expr: {namespace="$namespace"} | json | event="clip_report" | line_format "{{.song}} · {{.problem}} · clip {{.start_ms}}-{{.end_ms}} ms · correction start {{.shift_start_ms}} ms, end {{.shift_end_ms}} ms"

panels.title: Transcriptions by outcome
panels.description: Mic recordings sent to Orchardrun: text = something heard (then searched); empty = nothing understood (often singing or noise); failed = Orchardrun refused or didn't answer (see Errors)

panels.title: Paid calls, last 24 h
panels.description: Every recording is a paid Orchardrun call. The app stops at 500 a day for the whole site (and 60 per visitor); 429s show in Rate-limited requests (route transcribe)

panels.title: Latest transcriptions
panels.description: What Orchardrun heard (the text then goes to the search box). Failed ones show the upstream error
